To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) ALT events are common in CHB mothers; 2) elevated ALT levels and HBV DNA levels at delivery are independent risk factors for ALT events; and 3) an HBV DNA level cut‐off value of 5 log 10 IU/mL at the time of delivery may help identify CHB mothers who are at high risk of ALT events.
